# S206 — ork pins a project's adj contract and checks the pin

**Findings:** Owner 2026-10-30: adj half split out of S24; waits on adjudicate S45 (adj-json contract and pin) · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**2026-10-31** — **2026-10-30** — Waits on adjudicate S45 (not started on 2026-10-30; adj main 656a7c1 has no contract command). Do not start before S45 lands and the interface above is checked against it.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:** the slicer pin (S24), any change to adj (adjudicate S45 adds `adj contract`), and storing a pin in `projects.json`.

## Why

Split out of S24 on 2026-10-30 (owner, interactive): v1.0 pins and checks slicer's contract only. adj 97 (`boundary.contract-pin`, decided `ork-sets-checks`) still holds for adj: ork sets and checks adj's pin too, once adjudicate S45 ships `adj contract`.

ork decodes adj's JSON at `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go:62-88`. adj JSON shapes may change in any 0.x minor release (`adjudicate/docs/json.md:14-19`), and doctor only runs `adj --version` and compares it against nothing (`internal/cli/doctor.go:57-78`). A shape change reaches ork as a decode error, not as a refusal naming a version.

Proposed interface from adjudicate S45 (unverified until it lands; confirm against `adj contract --help`): `adj contract --json` returns `version` and `pinned`, `adj --root P contract pin M` writes `contract` in `.adjudicate.json`, and adj refuses its JSON commands on a mismatch.

Until this lands, an adj with no `contract` command (installed v0.1.0 prints: unknown command "contract") counts as unpinned: doctor warns and passes, and engine start does not refuse.

Rules to carry over from S24: `acceptedAdjContracts = []int{1}` beside the relay set with `AcceptedAdjContracts` and `AdjContractAccepted` (comment cites 97); `adjcli.Contract(ctx, root)`; `ork projects pin NAME --adj M` and `unpin --adj`, run after the slicer call and not at all if it fails; the adj column in the doctor project list; the adj pin check at engine start before the first adj read. Needs a spec round against S45's landed interface before it is ready.
